"sprintf"	"%[1"	"int"	"%!(NOVERB)"
"sprintf"	"%[-1]d"	"int"	"%!d(BADINDEX)"
"sprintf"	"%[99999999999]d"	"int"	"%!d(BADINDEX)"
"sprintf"	"%[2]*[1]d|"	"int,uint"	"    -42|"

"sprintf"	"%[2].2d"	"int,uint"	"%!d(BADINDEX)"

"sprintf"	"%"	""	"%!(NOVERB)"
"sprintf"	"%-"	""	"%!(NOVERB)"
